st: An alternative to the “9-to-5” office job: The Pathless Path

sec.t: ff.62.1 Work has never been so important
sec.p: With the pandemic interruption breaking our habits, we also started questioning work (and its routine), perhaps realising how arbitrary certain paradigms are.
In The Pathless Path, Paul Miller tells the story of his “escape” from the beaten path.
Money and success are the only paradigm to have survived the destruction of values of recent years.

sec.t: ff.62.4 The pyramid inside all of us
sec.p: La società moderna ha perfezionato l’arte di far sentire le persone non necessarie. Sebastian Junger,Tribù. Ritorno a casa e appartenenza
